unit_note: one entry per (vault table, run, business-key column): a REGISTRY, i.e. one identifier population feeding that key space.
risk_note: Unifying the hash form does NOT establish that the two runs' identifier spaces denote the same entities. 6 of the 14 shared hubs have ZERO BK-column overlap between the runs. Each shared hub's model header says so. A false merge is unrecoverable after load.
namespace_scope_note: The 'HUB_X|' namespace separates HUBS, not registries WITHIN a hub: 'HUB_POLICY|' prefixes POLICY_REF and POLICY_NO identically.
